label: Permit not obtained in time
description: Permit applied for after arrival (import) or after departure (export)
corrective_action: Apply for the permit before arrival or cargo lodgement; goods already imported without a permit need a voluntary disclosure

label: Importer UEN or account issue
description: UEN missing or malformed; Customs account not activated; importer name or UEN on the permit differs from the customer
corrective_action: Correct the importer fields (amend or cancel and re-apply) and the customer master data

label: HS code not valid
description: HS code has the wrong format or its first 6 digits are not an HS 2022 subheading
corrective_action: Correct the code in the product master and amend the permit

label: Classification query
description: HS code is valid but Customs queries whether it fits the goods description
corrective_action: Provide product literature; consider a classification ruling; update the product master

label: Customs value query
description: Declared value differs from the invoice or the CIF value (freight or insurance not added)
corrective_action: Recompute the CIF value and amend the permit; voluntary disclosure if the permit was already used

label: Invoice incomplete
description: Commercial invoice lacks a required field (number; date; currency; Incoterm; line description; quantity or price)
corrective_action: Request a corrected commercial invoice and add the field to the customer's invoice checklist

label: Competent-authority approval missing
description: Controlled goods declared without the licence or approval of the competent authority (HSA; SFA; IMDA; NEA and others)
corrective_action: Obtain the licence or approval and record its number in the handling note before re-submitting

label: Origin documents
description: Preference claimed without a certificate of origin; or origin declared as the port-of-loading country
corrective_action: Obtain the certificate of origin or pay the general rate and claim a refund; correct the origin field

label: Documents do not agree
description: Quantities or weights differ between invoice; packing list and bill of lading or air waybill; or a document is missing
corrective_action: Reconcile with supplier and forwarder and obtain corrected documents

label: Inspection without document defect
description: Risk-based or random examination where the documents were in order
corrective_action: Arrange the inspection; no document correction

label: Biosecurity referral (Australia)
description: Goods referred for biosecurity because import conditions; treatment or a permit were not met
corrective_action: Check BICON for the commodity and obtain the permit or treatment certificate
